reason: Every submitted offset goes into all_offsets in add_offset (patch lines 84-88, 239, 330, 348), and mark_committed only drops offsets <= the committed one (line 133), so an unfinished offset stays in all_offsets and the outstanding check at line 118 stops the scan there on every commit cycle.
